jobs.occupation: Administrative Assistant - Real Estate - Full Time or 4/5th
jobs.description:
As Administrative Assistant, you will provide operational and administrative support to the Estates team. The position would suit someone who genuinely enjoys administrative coordination, document follow-up and contract management, and who is comfortable working in a dynamic environment. You are fluent in French, Dutch and English. The position is possible in 4/5th of Full Time.

 

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international company managing an extensive real estate portfolio across Belgium.The company offers a stable environment, a collaborative culture and the opportunity to contribute to projects that have a tangible impact across the country. They are located in Diegem and easily accessible by car, tram, bus and train.

 

Description

• Support administration and follow-up of lease renewals, acquisitions and ongoing property files.
• Review contracts, interpret and gather relevant information.
• Manage correspondence and DocuSign signature processes.
• Ensure accurate filing and document management.
• Follow up with landlords regarding contractual and administrative matters.
• Support invoice processing and administrative reporting.
• Prepare reports, presentations and meeting documentation.
• Coordinate with various internal stakeholders and ensure proper follow-up of actions.

• A few years of experience in an administrative, coordination, file managment or property-related support role.
• Exposure to property management, lease administration, real estate, notary or similar environments is a strong asset.
• Proactive; organised and adaptable personality, able to support different stakeholders and managers.
• Professional level French and Dutch, with a good level of English.

ABOUT THE JOB
 
 

• Advising clients ranging from innovative start-ups to multinational companies on trademark, design and related IP matters. 

• Managing national, European and international trademark and design portfolios. 

• Conducting trademark clearance searches and providing availability opinions. 

• Drafting, filing and prosecuting trademark and design applications before the BOIP, EUIPO, WIPO and foreign intellectual property offices. 

• Handling opposition, cancellation and invalidity proceedings. 

• Advising on infringement, unfair competition and IP enforcement strategies. 

• Drafting legal opinions, cease-and-desist letters, coexistence agreements, assignments and licence agreements. 

• Assisting clients in developing and implementing pragmatic IP protection strategies. 

• Liaising with clients, foreign associates and intellectual property offices worldwide. 

• Monitoring legislative and case law developments and translating these into practical advice for clients. 

• Working closely with a team of experienced attorneys, legal professionals and paralegals.  

YOUR PROFILE
 
 

• Education: Master's degree in Law, preferably with an additional qualification in Intellectual Property. 

• Experience: Some experience in IP law and/or trademark and design protection, preferably in private practice. 

• Languages: Excellent written and oral communication skills in Dutch and English; other languages are a plus. 

• Mindset: Pragmatic, proactive, client-oriented, and self-motivated. 

• Skills: Attention to detail, ability to handle confidential cases discreetly, and strong prioritization skills. 

• Teamwork: Ability to work both individually and seamlessly within a team.

The Production/Finishing Department has an exciting opportunity for a results-driven Process Engineer.

Purpose of the Role

You will develop and implement manufacturing methods to ensure production is carried out in the safest, highest-quality, and most cost-effective manner.

Working from within the production environment, you will collaborate closely with Quality, Engineering & Maintenance, Supply Chain, Business teams, and other stakeholders to improve safety, quality, delivery performance, and productivity. 

Key Responsibilities
 
• Investigate and resolve issues arising during the manufacturing process. 
• Drive operational excellence initiatives by identifying improvement opportunities, reducing losses, optimizing processes, and improving equipment reliability. 
• Identify and analyze process improvement opportunities to enhance productivity, quality, safety, and cost efficiency, and lead improvement projects across production and supporting departments. 
• Facilitate and support change management activities. 
• Ensure that improvements are properly documented, standardized, and embedded within operational processes. 
Profile / Qualifications
 
• Master's degree or an experienced Professional Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Industrial Sciences, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related technical field. 
• Proven experience in a manufacturing or production environment. 
• Experience with process analysis, data analysis, and performance management. 
• Knowledge of Power BI, OT/IT systems, Six Sigma, or similar analytical tools is considered an asset. 
• Fluent in Dutch and English. 
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 
• Hands-on mentality with the ability to translate ideas into practical improvements. 
• Effective communication skills with the ability to engage a variety of stakeholders. 
• Ability to work both independently and within multidisciplinary teams.

As a 
Claims Handler, you will manage maritime and transport claims from A to Z. You will act as a key contact for our clients and coordinate the different parties involved throughout the claims process.
 

Your day-to-day work includes assessing incoming claims, coordinating surveys, reviewing documentation and reports, investigating the cause and extent of damage, calculating claim amounts and preparing final reports. You will also maintain close contact with brokers, exporters, insurers, surveyors, lawyers and other partners, representing the interests of our clients throughout the process.
 

The role offers a high degree of 
autonomy and 
responsibility, combined with an international and varied range of contacts.

We are looking for a proactive and organised person with an analytical mindset and strong communication skills. You enjoy taking ownership of cases, working with different stakeholders and finding practical solutions for clients.
 

Experience or knowledge in 
claims, insurance, logistics, transport or the 
 maritime sector is an advantage, but is not a requirement.
 

We are equally interested in candidates with a relevant background and a strong willingness to learn.
 

You are comfortable working in an international environment and have a strong command of 
English, both written and spoken.

Your role
For one of our most prestigious clients in Brussels, we are looking for an Office & Reception Collaborator to take on a key hospitality and coordination role within the site.

You will work in an international and highly professional environment, welcoming and supporting a community that includes diplomatic members and high-level visitors.

This position goes beyond traditional reception duties. You will become a central point of contact for the floor, ensuring that daily operations run smoothly, events are properly coordinated and every visitor and member receives a consistently high level of hospitality.

The position represents 37 hours of work per week.
Your mission
Your first objective will be to develop an excellent understanding of the entire floor, its organisation, its community and its operating protocols.

As the position involves regular interaction with diplomatic members and visitors, professionalism, discretion and respect for established protocols are essential.

Together with your colleague on the floor, you will ensure the smooth coordination of daily activities and maintain a welcoming, organised and professional environment.
Your main responsibilities
• Welcome members, visitors and guests in a warm and professional manner
• Learn and follow the specific protocols and procedures applicable to the floor
• Coordinate and organise events, meetings and activities taking place on the floor
• Prepare and monitor meeting rooms and shared spaces
• Ensure that coffee machines and hospitality areas are operational, clean and properly supplied
• Coordinate daily operational and hospitality requirements
• Work closely with your floor colleague to ensure continuity and an effective distribution of responsibilities
• Anticipate needs and respond proactively to requests from members and visitors
• Coordinate with internal teams, suppliers and relevant service providers when required
• Follow up on existing community services, including access-related services, dry cleaning and other concierge services
• Support administrative tasks and maintain clear operational follow-up
• Contribute actively to creating a genuine sense of hospitality and community throughout the floorWorking schedule
This is a 37-hour-per-week position.

A standard working schedule will be established. However, flexibility is an important part of the role, as working hours may occasionally be adapted according to the client's needs, scheduled events and the level of activity on the floor.

We are therefore looking for someone who is comfortable working within a structured schedule while remaining flexible when operational needs require it.
 Your profile
For this position, we are looking for someone who combines excellent hospitality skills with strong organisational abilities.

You:

• Have a strong sense of hospitality and genuinely enjoy working with people
• Are highly organised, structured and able to manage several priorities
• Have good working knowledge of Microsoft Office
• Communicate professionally and confidently with different types of guests and stakeholders
• Understand the importance of discretion, confidentiality and professional conduct
• Are comfortable working in an international and diplomatic environment
• Are proactive and capable of identifying what needs to be done without always waiting for instructions
• Enjoy working as part of a two-person team while also being capable of working independently
• Are physically comfortable moving regularly throughout the floor during the working day
• Are flexible regarding working hours when events or operational requirements require adjustments
• Are eligible to meet the client's applicable security and background requirements
• Are available to start as soon as possibleLanguages
As you will be working in an international environment, strong language skills are essential:

• English is mandatory
• Fluency in at least one of Belgium's national languages - French, Dutch or German - is mandatory
• Knowledge of additional languages is highly appreciated and considered an asset
Previous experience in corporate reception, hospitality, front office, office support, events or workplace services is a strong asset.
 What we offer
We offer a fixed-term contract (CDD) of 37 hours per week, with the perspective of developing into a permanent contract (CDI).

You will join one of our most prestigious client environments and take on a position with real responsibility and visibility within the site.

You can also expect:

• A professional and international working environment
• A key role combining reception, office support, hospitality and event coordination
• A high level of autonomy and responsibility
• Close collaboration with another colleague on the floor
• The opportunity to build strong relationships with an international community
• A position where your ideas, initiative and organisational skills can make a real difference
• Salary and benefits in accordance with the applicable Belgian employment conditionsMore than a reception role
This position is ultimately about creating an experience.

Beyond supporting meetings, events and daily operations, your role is to make people feel welcome, supported and part of a community.

You will be one of the key people responsible for bringing hospitality, organisation and a human touch to the floor every day.
Ready to Join Ask Nestor?
If you are passionate about facilities, hospitality, and operational excellence, and you enjoy creating exceptional workplace experiences, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of the Ask Nestor team.

As a Senior Data Architect, you will be responsible for defining and implementing the enterprise-wide data architecture that supports critical business initiatives and drives data-driven decision-making. You'll shape the structure, governance, and strategic roadmap of data assets across the organization¿ensuring data is accessible, secure, integrated, and aligned with evolving business needs.

You'll collaborate with senior stakeholders in IT, analytics, and the business to architect scalable data solutions across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid environments¿balancing innovation with long-term sustainability.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Design and evolve enterprise data architecture, aligning with business strategies and regulatory requirements.
• Lead data modelling efforts across operational and analytical domains (OLTP/OLAP), including conceptual, logical, and physical models.
• Promote a hands-on, pragmatic approach towards data architecture and the overall team dynamic
• Define and implement data standards, policies, and governance frameworks.
• Guide the architecture of data platforms, support self-service, AI, Dashboarding and real-time streaming solutions.
• Partner with Data Engineers, Analysts, Architects, and Business stakeholders to ensure data quality, accessibility, and lineage.
• Influence senior stakeholders and business owners across the organisation (38K, global)
• Evaluate and recommend technologies and tools for data integration, storage, cataloguing, and analytics.
• Ensure data architecture enables AI/ML, advanced analytics, and reporting initiatives.
• Support compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, or other regulatory standards depending on the region/industry.
• Provide architectural oversight and leadership across data-related projects and programs.
• Mentor junior data architects and engineers, contributing to a strong data architecture community. 
We do not only deliver letters and parcels, but also opportunities. This job is open to all with diverse backgrounds and talents, possessing the following profile:  
 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field.
• 8+ years of experience in large scale data architecture or related fields (over 100m events); 3+ years in a senior or enterprise role.
• Strong hands-on expertise in data architecture design for cloud (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP) and hybrid environments.
• Deep knowledge of data modelling techniques, ETL/ELT pipelines, automation (CICD scripting, Airflow...) and data lifecycle management.
• Experience with streaming data is a strong asset (Kafka, Flink...). Experience with Semantic integration and Ontology also assets.
• Familiarity with modern data stacks: Snowflake, Databricks, DBT, etc.
• Understanding of data security, master data management (MDM), data mesh, and metadata management.
• Excellent communication (business fluent English, French and/or Dutch are a plus) and leadership skills with the ability to translate complex data topics for business audiences.
• Experience working in Agile or DevOps environments is a plus.
• 2 days per week (minimum) hybrid office presence.

• Knowledge of sensors, motors, electrical components and technical installations.	
• Experience with or an interest in SCADA and CMMS systems.

They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.
